rows.quote: Breast cancer GWAS summary statistics were obtained from the Breast Cancer Association Consortium (BCAC; IEU identifier: ieu-a-1126), comprising 122,977 BC cases and 105,974 controls with genome-wide data on approximately 15 million common variants.25,26
rows.coder_note: The sentence gives the OpenGWAS accession ieu-a-1126, which no dictionary row lists (rules B, G). For adjudication: the same sentence cites reference 26 (Michailidou 2017, DOI 10.1038/nature24284) and gives 122,977 cases and 105,974 controls, the DOI and counts of the row BCAC breast cancer (Michailidou 2017).

The only sentence that attributes the Fenland pQTL data to a citation (Pietzner et al, reference 23, DOI 10.1126/science.abj1541) occurs twice in the source with identical neighbouring sentences; citations pin refused it as ambiguous and the occurrence helper raised for both passages (p005, p007), so nothing is pinned. The other sentences give only the cohort name, approximately 10,700 adults and approximately 4,000 SomaScan proteins.

rows.quote: METHODS: Plasma protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) from the Fenland cohort (~10,700 individuals) and the FinnGen R10 SomaScan subset (n = 828) were integrated with breast cancer genome-wide association study data from the Breast Cancer Association Consortium (122,977 cases and 105,974 controls).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names a FinnGen R10 SomaScan pQTL subset (n = 828); the dictionary has no pQTL row for FinnGen.
